posts.title: World of Warcraft Forever
posts.description: After almost two decades away, I've returned to World of Warcraft. World of Warcraft Forever was released earlier this month, and because I have such good memories from playing in the early 2000s, I decided to jump into it and make a new character to explore the world of Azeroth once more. posts.title: October 2026 Books
posts.description: I have to say something about the elections here in the US last night before I dive into October's books. WE DID IT. I'm feeling more hopeful than I have in a long time, and I just want to give everyone a hug. I can't wait to see what happens now. I'm disappointed in my own state of Tennessee, though. While watching other southern states like Texas and Georgia flip to blue, my state remained red.
